articles.title: Festival da Resistência: música e arte no Dia da Consciência Negra | G1
articles.standfirst: Evento gratuito será realizado nesta sexta-feira (20), na Casa de Cultura Villa Maria, com apresentações musicais, feira criativa e ação solidária.
articles.summary: O Festival da Resistência em Campos celebra o Dia da Consciência Negra com shows, cinema e feira criativa na Villa Maria, arrecadando alimentos para doação solidária.
articles.body:
Festival da Resistência conta com shows, poesia e exposições no Dia da Consciência Negra em Campos — Foto: Divulgação

O Dia da Consciência Negra será celebrado com música, poesia, arte e atividades culturais em Campos dos Goytacazes , no Norte Fluminense. Nesta sexta-feira (20), a partir das 14h, a Casa de Cultura Villa Maria, da Universidade Estadual do Norte Fluminense Darcy Ribeiro (Uenf), recebe a segunda edição do Festival da Resistência.

A programação é gratuita e reúne artistas da região, DJs, apresentações de poesia, exposições e feira de economia criativa.

Entre as atrações musicais estão a Banda Tubarão Martelo, que celebra 15 anos de trajetória, o cantor Marcelo Benjá, Daiane Gomes, Mari Honorato e banda e o projeto James Coroico, do músico Luiz Bento. A programação também terá discotecagem dos DJs Jason e Meu Mel, além de apresentações do Slam do Patrocínio, com poetas da região.

O público poderá visitar exposições de artistas campistas. Entre elas estão a BAR.ulho Ilustrado, que reúne diferentes manifestações artísticas inspiradas na boemia da cidade, e a mostra coletiva Ururau da Arte, com trabalhos de seis artistas em linguagens como fotografia, pintura, vídeo, performance e desenho.

A programação inclui ainda a Mostra Cine Afroraiz, com exibição de curtas-metragens que abordam temas relacionados à história, às raízes e às lutas da população negra. Após as sessões, haverá um bate-papo com integrantes das equipes dos filmes. Para participar dessa atividade, é necessário fazer inscrição prévia, já que as vagas são limitadas.

Além das atrações culturais, o festival terá uma feira de economia criativa, com artesanato e produtos de gastronomia e confeitaria. A entrada é gratuita, com doação voluntária de um quilo de alimento não perecível. Os donativos serão destinados ao Projeto Mãos na Comunidade, que atua na região da Chatuba, em Guarus.

O evento é organizado pelo Coletivo Cultural Resistência Goytacá, em parceria com a Casa Afroraiz, Saturnália Produções e Veneno da Laje. A primeira edição foi realizada em julho de 2023. O coletivo atua desde 2015 na produção de eventos culturais e na valorização de artistas independentes da região.

Horário : a partir das 14h (As exposições ficam abertas à visitação até as 18h)

Local : Casa de Cultura Villa Maria – UENF, em Campos dos Goytacazes

Entrada : gratuita, com doação voluntária de 1 kg de alimento não perecível.

articles.title: Amapá Sabor: Festival gastronômico reúne 24 restaurantes em Macapá | G1
articles.standfirst: Evento está na 17ª edição e reúne 24 restaurantes no anfiteatro da Fortaleza de São José de Macapá até domingo (22).
articles.summary: O festival Amapá Sabor reúne 24 restaurantes e shows na Fortaleza de São José de Macapá até domingo, valorizando a culinária amapaense e o turismo local.
articles.body:
A turista Joana Dark desembarcou no Amapá pela primeira vez e aproveitou para conhecer a culinária do Norte na 17ª edição do Festival Amapá Sabor. O evento ocorre até domingo (22), no anfiteatro da Fortaleza de São José, no Centro de Macapá .

Com entrada gratuita, o festival reúne 24 restaurantes de diferentes segmentos, das 17h às 23h, e conta com shows no Palco Sesc – Sabores e Música (veja a programação completa no fim da matéria).

O evento funciona como uma vitrine da cultura local e destaca pratos que valorizam ingredientes típicos da culinária amapaense.

Durante a visita, Joana experimentou a maniçoba, prato típico da região que, segundo ela, está mais que aprovado.

"Eu não conhecia Macapá . Estou fechando um circuito pelo Brasil, conhecendo o Norte, faltavam Roraima e Amapá. Agora vou provar a maniçoba; na minha terra também fazem, mas a daqui é bem diferente", disse a turista.

Turista Joana Dark, no festival Amapá Sabor — Foto: Mariana Ferreira/g1

A empreendedora Vilma Oliveira participa do festival mais uma vez. Ela acompanha o Amapá Sabor desde a primeira edição e vê o evento como uma oportunidade para impulsionar o turismo e a economia do estado.

"Isso é muito importante para a nossa gastronomia. Participo do Amapá Sabor desde a primeira edição, então é muito bom, porque o público comparece e a economia do estado fica aquecida", afirmou.

Os restaurantes estão divididos em estandes para apresentar ao público uma amostra do cardápio oferecido nas lojas físicas e incentivar visitas aos estabelecimentos.

17ª edição do Festival Amapá Sabor — Foto: Mariana Ferreira/g1

Além disso, o público conta com um espaço dedicado à agricultura familiar e com a Cozinha Show, que oferece oficinas temáticas diferentes a cada noite.

Uma das novidades desta edição é uma área voltada ao turismo, criada para que os visitantes conheçam as empresas e os serviços oferecidos no estado.

Segundo a diretora regional do Sesc Amapá, Êmile Pereira, turismo e gastronomia são setores que se complementam e reforçam o potencial do estado.

"É um evento feito pelo comércio amapaense para o próprio comércio e para a população. Mostra a força da nossa identidade por meio da culinária e da cultura local. Neste ano, trouxemos o turismo, dando o pontapé inicial para o Natal; as agências estão aqui para que o público conheça os roteiros e, quem sabe, já planeje as férias", explicou.

A proposta é movimentar a economia criativa e gerar oportunidades de negócios para os empreendedores locais às vésperas das festas de Natal.

O vice-presidente do Sindicato de Hospedagem, Alimentação e Entretenimento do Amapá (Shaea) e presidente da Associação Comercial e Industrial do Amapá (Acia), Márcio Bragança, destaca que o festival celebra a gastronomia e a cultura amazônica.

"Vejo que nossos empreendedores estão cada vez melhores, e esse é um grande incentivo para gerar boas vendas no período de Natal. É o momento de mostrarem tudo o que há de bom no Amapá e que, às vezes, nem é conhecido", destacou.

articles.title: Agenda cultural Belém: Roupa Nova e Festival Amajazzon são destaques | G1
articles.standfirst: Programação de quinta-feira (19) a domingo (22) reúne grandes apresentações musicais, rodas de samba, feiras gastronômicas e exposições.
articles.summary: A agenda cultural Belém destaca o show do Roupa Nova, o Festival Amajazzon e diversas programações gratuitas de Consciência Negra entre os dias 19 e 22 de dezembro.
articles.body:
Atrações da agenda cultural do g1 Pará — Foto: Divulgação

A agenda cultural desta semana em Belém está repleta de opções para todos os gostos e idades. De quinta-feira (19) a domingo (22), quem estiver pela cidade poderá aproveitar uma programação diversa que inclui grandes shows, festivais de música eletrônica e gastronomia, celebrações do Dia da Consciência Negra e passeios gratuitos.

Entre os principais destaques estão a apresentação da banda Roupa Nova , o show comemorativo "Trilogia 23 Anos" , que celebra a cultura amazônica, e a terceira edição do Festival AMAJAZZON , que promove um encontro de grandes nomes da música instrumental brasileira e internacional.

Além dos destaques, há opções variadas para curtir o fim de semana. Confira a seleção do g1 abaixo, dividida pelas seguintes categorias:

Roupa Nova faz apresentação no Palco Sunset — Foto: Reprodução

Com 45 anos de estrada e a mesma formação, a banda Roupa Nova chega com a turnê "Simplesmente Roupa Nova", uma apresentação que promete emocionar o público. O grupo, dono de sucessos que marcaram gerações e trilhas sonoras de novelas, traz um repertório repleto de clássicos e homenagens ao saudoso vocalista Paulinho.

📅 Quando? 20 de dezembro de 2025. Abertura dos portões às 21h; banda de abertura às 21h30; show do Roupa Nova às 23h

📍 Onde? Assembléia Paraense (Av. Almirante Barroso, 4.614, Souza)

💲 Quanto? Ingressos divididos por setores (Mesa Premium, Mesa Ouro, Pista e Camarotes)

➡ Mais informações: Vendas online (com 15% de taxa) ou na bilheteria oficial física no Shopping Boulevard (sem taxa). Classificação: 18 anos. Há gratuidade garantida por lei para idosos e PcD no setor Pista.

Trilogia 23 Anos — Foto: Marivaldo Pascoal/Divulgação

Em comemoração aos 23 anos de união, os artistas Mahrco, Lucinnha e Nilson apresentam o show "Trilogia". Comprometidos com a cultura regional, o trio traz ao palco um repertório que celebra a natureza, com mensagens em defesa dos rios e da floresta, relembrando sucessos de espetáculos como "A força que vem das ruas" e "Ser do Norte".

📅 Quando? Sexta-feira (20), às 20h (abertura dos portões às 19h)

📍 Onde? Theatro da Paz (Praça da República, s/n, Centro)

💲 Quanto? De R$ 50 (meia-entrada, setor Paraíso) a R$ 200 (inteira, setores Plateia, Varanda e Frisa)

➡ Mais informações: Classificação indicativa de 12 anos. Tolerância máxima de 15 minutos para entrada após o início. Ingressos à venda na bilheteria física e online.

A cantora e compositora Juliana Linhares, o pianista pernambucano Amaro Freitas e o baterista norueguês Thomas Strønen — Foto: Divulgação

A terceira edição do Festival AMAJAZZON reúne nomes do jazz e da música brasileira, promovendo o intercâmbio entre artistas de diferentes regiões e do exterior. A programação conta com apresentações do pianista pernambucano Amaro Freitas, da cantora potiguar Juliana Linhares, do baterista norueguês Thomas Strønen, além da Amazônia Jazz Band e de um ensemble universitário.

📍 Onde? Theatro da Paz (Avenida da Paz, Praça da República, s/n, Campina)

➡ Mais informações: Ingressos à venda online pelo site Ticket Fácil

Lançamento do álbum "Tropical Da Mata", de Priscila Cobra

"Tropical Da Mata", de Priscila Cobra — Foto: Divulgação

A multiartista afro-indígena Priscila Cobra lança o álbum digital "Tropical Da Mata" no Dia da Consciência Negra. O trabalho de estreia conta com quatro faixas autorais que unem o tradicional carimbó "pau e corda" a influências da diáspora africana. Com temáticas que abordam resistência, feminismo e a comunidade LGBTQIA+, o disco celebra os 10 anos de trajetória da cantora.

📍 Onde? Disponível nas principais plataformas digitais de streaming e no Bandcamp

➡ Mais informações: Lançamento digital pelo selo Tropical Diaspora Records

Mariza Black comanda fim de semana de samba em Belém — Foto: Divulgação

Para celebrar o Dia da Consciência Negra, a cantora Mariza Black comanda uma roda de samba com repertório que exalta a ancestralidade e a resistência da população negra. Acompanhada por uma banda completa e convidados especiais, como Rafaela Travassos e Pedrão Frade, a artista apresenta canções conhecidas nas vozes de Jorge Aragão, Zeca Pagodinho e Clara Nunes.

📅 Quando? Sexta-feira (20), às 20h; e domingo (22), às 11h e às 14h30

📍 Onde? Bar e Restaurante Quintal da Rizzo (Rua Mundurucus, 1.595, Batista Campos) e Memorial dos Povos (Av. Gov. José Malcher, 257, Nazaré)

💲 Quanto? R$ 15 (Quintal da Rizzo) e gratuito (Memorial dos Povos)

➡ Mais informações: Ingressos vendidos no local

Festa CRUJ+Vraah 'Especial Britney Spears'

Para celebrar os 25 anos do álbum "Britney", a festa CRUJ & VRAAH promove uma edição especial dedicada à Princesinha do Pop. O evento passeia por toda a discografia da cantora e relembra os maiores hits dos anos 2000, com discotecagem comandada pelos DJs Tiana, Allan Ramos e Saxxa.

📍 Onde? Liv Club - R. Gaspar Viana, 1239 - Reduto

💲 Quanto? Valores não informados; ingressos vendidos via plataforma Shotgun

➡ Mais informações: Evento com apoio de @britneyonlinebrasil

Durante três dias, o Festival Vozes da Floresta reúne 30 DJs de música eletrônica. A programação conta com pioneiros do psy trance no Brasil, como Juarez Petrillo (DJ Swarup) e Adriana Peres Franco (DJ Ekanta) — pais do DJ Alok. O evento propõe conectar o público à natureza com ritmos que vão do log e P.M. ao trance.

📅 Quando? Quinta-feira (19), sexta-feira (20) e sábado (21)

➡ Mais informações: Pelo perfil oficial no Instagram (@vozesdafloresfsta)

A tradicional Banda Sayonara comanda o evento "TBT a Bordo", uma viagem musical pelas águas. O projeto une entretenimento e nostalgia, resgatando grandes sucessos em um cenário diferente. A programação conta ainda com participações especiais de artistas como Jorginho Silva, Joelson Pantoja, Nívea Magno, Márcia Rocha, Conca Saavedra e Marcelo Góes.

📅 Quando? Domingo (22). Concentração a partir das 14h; saída da embarcação às 15h e previsão de retorno às 19h

📍 Onde? Marina Regional (Avenida Bernardo Sayão, 3.852)

➡ Mais informações: Pelo telefone (91) 99298-3036

A primeira edição do projeto encerra sua programação celebrando a música nas ruas da Cidade Velha. O evento gratuito reúne diferentes gerações com shows de Ribamar José, Alberto Moreno, Gabriel Luz, Maria Lu, Cristtian Miranda, Nego Tayson e Banda Fruta Quente.

📅 Quando? Domingo (22), a partir das 18h

📍 Onde? Avenida Tamandaré com Travessa Carlos de Carvalho, Cidade Velha

➡ Mais informações: Evento aberto a todos os públicos

Feira Dose Amazônica com Banda Reggaetown

O evento Dose Amazônica reúne empreendedorismo, música, gastronomia e coquetelaria. Com formato de feira de comercialização, o espaço conta com 12 expositores de alimentos e bebidas, além de oferecer cozinha show e degustações. A atração musical desta quinta-feira fica por conta da Banda Reggaetown.

📅 Quando? Quinta-feira (19), a partir das 17h

📍 Onde? Vila Domos do Sebrae (Rua Boaventura da Silva, Umarizal)

Grupo do Pará, Reggaetown aposta em versões reggae de clássicos da música brasileira e internacional — Foto: Divulgação

A primeira edição "Smash" do Festival Dia Mundial do Hambúrguer reúne dez hamburguerias com foco na técnica de prensar a carne diretamente na chapa. Além de opções gastronômicas com preços acessíveis, o evento conta com programação musical gratuita todos os dias, incluindo apresentações de Nosso Tom, Banda Reggaetown, William Cézar e Christiano, Aline Alves e DJs.

📅 Quando? De quinta-feira (19) a domingo (22)

💲 Quanto? Entrada gratuita para o evento

➡ Mais informações: Pelo perfil oficial no Instagram (@diamundialdohamburguerpa)

Banda Vingadores do Brega se apresenta neste sábado em Belém — Foto: Reprodução

A Paróquia Cristo Rei promove uma programação especial de confraternização para a comunidade. Com entrada gratuita, o evento conta com apresentações musicais para animar o público. Na reta final da festividade, os destaques são os shows de Netto Acordeon e Martin Blue na sexta-feira (20); Banda Amazonas no sábado (21); e Vingadores do Brega no domingo (22).

📍 Onde? Paróquia Cristo Rei (Rua Liberdade, s/n, Guanabara)

➡ Mais informações: Pelo telefone (91) 3235-1405

Programação da Consciência Negra no Banco da Amazônia

O Centro Cultural Banco da Amazônia promove uma programação especial e gratuita em alusão ao Dia da Consciência Negra. Nesta sexta-feira, o espaço recebe a Feira Cultural Matriarcas, com empreendedoras negras, além de oficinas de gastronomia (preparo de acarajé) e de moda afro (turbantes e tranças). O encerramento conta com um desfile de moda com as produções das oficinas.

📅 Quando? Sexta-feira (20), das 10h às 18h (oficinas e desfile em horários específicos ao longo do dia)

📍 Onde? Foyer do Centro Cultural Banco da Amazônia (Avenida Presidente Vargas, 800, Campina)

💲 Quanto? Entrada gratuita (oficinas requerem inscrição prévia no local)

Programação da Consciência Negra na Estação Cultural de Icoaraci

Estação Cultural de Icoaraci, em Belém. — Foto: Leandro Tocantins / Secult

A Estação Cultural de Icoaraci promove dois dias de atividades gratuitas para celebrar o Dia da Consciência Negra e valorizar a cultura afro-brasileira. A programação inclui feira de artesanato e gastronomia, exibição de documentário, palestra e diversas apresentações de música e dança, com destaque para a celebração de oito anos da Cia Amazônica de Danças.

📅 Quando? Sexta-feira (20) e sábado (21), a partir das 18h

Mostras no Centro Cultural Banco da Amazônia

Além da programação especial da Consciência Negra, o Centro Cultural Banco da Amazônia está com três exposições em cartaz abertas ao público: "Burle Marx – Expedição Amazônia", "Fluxos", do fotógrafo Miguel Chikaoka, e a "Mostra de Grafismo Cultura Viva".

📅 Quando? Visitação de terça a sexta-feira, das 10h às 18h; sábados, domingos e feriados, das 10h às 14h

📍 Onde? Centro Cultural Banco da Amazônia (Avenida Presidente Vargas, 800, Campina)

articles.title: Netflix actor dead at 38 after jumping off Santa Monica pier, as cops launch suicide probe
articles.summary: He was a background actor in several Netflix shows, including "You" and "The Rookie."
articles.body:
Alexander Haskin has died after jumping off a Southern California pier . He was 38.

The background actor, who appeared in several shows, including "You," leapt off the Santa Monica Pier around 4 p.m. local time, authorities announced in a statement obtained by Page Six.

His body was located by a search-and-rescue team within the hour, and life-saving measures were unsuccessful.

According to the Santa Monica Police Department, Haskin was alone before the incident and didn't interact with others before jumping.

Authorities claimed there were no suspicious circumstances surrounding Haskin's death, which is being investigated as a suicide.

Haskin's identity was revealed after SMPD announced a man had died after they responded to a call about a man in the water on the west end of the pier.

Alexander's father, Dana Haskin, exclusively told the California Post that he last talked to his son earlier in the day.

While the patriarch refused to elaborate on the conversation, he claimed the conversation was brief and "brings up more questions" for their family.

Dana added that Alexander wasn't visibly distressed before the incident and looked forward to spending the holidays with his family.

Dana also noted that the "Rookie" background actor could swim, and he believed the decision to jump was rash and emotional.

"In the heat of the moment, who knows what a human brain can do?" Dana told the outlet. "It's still a big mystery to us … we keep asking why."

Before acting, Alexander was a military police officer in the Air Force and a personal trainer after graduating from Long Beach City College in 2010.

Aside from his father, Alexander is survived by his sister and three brothers.

Authorities have requested witnesses at the scene come forward with information related to the incident by contacting the Santa Monica Police Department at 310-458-8491.

If you or someone you know is affected by any of the issues raised in this story, call the National Suicide Prevention Lifeline at 800-273-TALK (8255) or text Crisis Text Line at 741741.

articles.title: Meta now sells 3D movies on Quest VR headsets
articles.summary: Meta now offers more than 150 3D movies that you can buy or rent to watch in VR on its Quest 3 and 3S headsets, the company announced today.
articles.body: Meta now offers more than 150 3D movies that you can buy or rent to watch in VR on its Quest 3 and 3S headsets, the company announced today. The movies are available in Meta’s TV app and include titles like Avatar, Spider-Man: Far From Home, Jurassic World Rebirth, Wicked: For Good, and a Billie Eilish concert film co-directed by Eilish and James Cameron. The company suggests watching movies in a Theater view that’s rolling out with a new Meta Quest update. Theater view “provides a big screen and dims your surroundings to create a cozy, personal cinema experience,” Meta says. Meta promises that the library will “keep growing, with thousands of titles and international availability coming” when it launches its VR Glasses next spring. If you’re a Disney Plus subscriber, you can also watch 3D movies on Meta Quest hardware in the Disney Plus app thanks to an update rolled out earlier this month.

articles.title: Fiona the hippo dies after eating a hat, Cincinnati Zoo says
articles.summary: Cincinnati Zoo’s beloved hippo Fiona has died following complications from eating a hat that was tossed by a visitor and ended up in her enclosure, the zoo announced Thursday.
articles.body: Cincinnati Zoo’s beloved hippo Fiona has died following complications from eating a hat that was tossed by a visitor and ended up in her enclosure, the zoo announced Thursday. She was 9. “It is with extreme sadness that we share with you the devastating news that Fiona did not make it after multiple attempts from our amazing vets and keeper team to help her through what ended up being a medical emergency,” the zoo said in a statement. Fiona had ingested a hat that ended up in her habitat “by accident” last week, zoo officials said. “Despite multiple attempts to move the hat out of her system, it was ultimately too much to overcome,” the zoo said in a statement. “The team performed necessary supportive care today in an attempt to save her, but it was not successful and she did not recover.” Fiona’s care team had tried multiple approaches to help her, including a having the hippo stand on a vibration plate with the hope it would encourage movement through her digestive tract, the zoo said. “We know everyone in the community will be crushed by this news, as we all are,” the statement said. The zoo asked the public to keep her caretakers in their thoughts. The knit hat got into Fiona’s habitat after it was tossed into the air by a visitor and got caught by a ceiling fan that catapulted it through a small opening above the area’s viewing windows, The Associated Press reported, citing zoo spokesperson Michelle Curley. Hippos are primarily herbivores with diets largely of grass. Dr. Gabriella Flacke, an associate veterinarian at Zoo Miami with expertise in hippos, told NBC News the hat was likely made of synthetic material that was not digestible to begin with. “It probably was trying to move through her intestines in much of the original state that it was in when it was ingested, and that clearly was too big to fit,” she said. Flacke said the hat could have soaked up fluid from her intestinal tract and became “more thickened and swollen.” “It didn’t fit through the intestine was basically what happened and and it couldn’t be broken down either,” she added. Experts will determine what happened when they conduct a necropsy. Flacke said there have been cases of hippos eating something they shouldn’t have, and most of those cases “resulted in the hippos not making it.” However, there have been instances in which the objects came out on the other side in their feces. She said surgery wasn’t an option for Fiona and would have been extremely high-risk. “Just because of the animal’s very large size, the pressure on the abdomen from their intestines, putting a lot of pressure on any type of incision that you would make. Also, the skin being very, very thick and not having like the same sort of anatomy as other mammal skin, like a dog or a horse or us, for example, doesn’t heal very well,” she said. Flacke remembered Fiona as “such a charismatic animal” who “had a really rough start in life and then beat all the odds.” Fiona became a global celebrity soon after her premature birth nearly a decade ago. She was born six weeks early in January 2017 and the world followed her progress online, rooting for the baby hippo to survive. Fiona quickly became a star: Books were written about her, she inspired a line of beer, and a couple got engaged in front of her exhibit. Cincinnati Mayor Aftab Pureval posted a tribute mourning Fiona’s passing. “Fiona was a symbol of perseverance and joy in Cincinnati. She brought smiles to so many faces, from kids to parents to visitors from around the world,” he said on X. “Our city is heartbroken, but we couldn’t be more grateful that she was part of our lives and our community as a whole.”

articles.title: Hayden Panettiere's mom says skipping daughter's funeral was 'probably for the best'
articles.summary: Lesley Vogel says she hadn't spoken to Hayden Panettiere for nearly a year before the "Heroes" star's accidental fentanyl overdose in Greenville.
articles.body: Hayden Panettiere's mother, Lesley Vogel, admitted that despite receiving an invitation, she didn't attend her daughter's funeral in September. Vogel recalled the last time she spoke with Panettiere was in "September or October of 2025" and told Inside Edition they had texted prior to her death in August from an accidental overdose. Vogel, who also served as Panettiere's manager throughout her childhood, cited her rising stardom as the catalyst for their fractured relationship before claiming that her daughter's boyfriend, Brian Hickerson, tore them apart further. HAYDEN PANETTIERE’S MOM DISCLOSES HEARTBREAKING ULTIMATUM IN THEIR FINAL PHONE CALL BEFORE ACTRESS’S DEATH When asked why she chose not to attend the services, Vogel said she was protecting her own peace and didn't want to "rock the boat." "I knew that some of the people there wanted to believe that I'm the horrible mother because Hayden was angry and made statements," Vogel said. "I just didn't want to rock the boat, either. It was probably for the best." Panettiere had an on-again, off-again relationship with Hickerson in the years before her death at 36. articles.title: Robert De Niro Sets the Record Straight About Jennifer Lawrence Asking Him to Leave Her Wedding Rehearsal Dinner
articles.summary: Lawrence said in a January 2024 interview that she whispered to De Niro, ‘Go home,’ at her October 2019 event
articles.body:
Jennifer Lawrence asked Robert De Niro to leave her wedding rehearsal dinner in October 2019, thinking he wasn't enjoying himself

De Niro clarified during Vanity Fair 's lie detector test in November 2026 that he was having an "okay" time despite not knowing many people at the event

The two share a playful friendship, which they've joked about publicly

Robert De Niro is explaining why Jennifer Lawrence asked him to leave her rehearsal dinner.

Lawrence, 36, married Cooke Maroney , 42, in October 2019 at the historic Belcourt of Newport mansion in Newport, Rhode Island. Just over four years later in January 2024, the actress said in an interview with E! News that her wedding experience was "stressful" at times, partially because she was consumed with ensuring guests were having fun. She recalled being especially concerned that De Niro, 83, wasn't having a good time at her rehearsal dinner and whispering to him, "Go home."

"I looked over and I saw Bob, who doesn't know anybody and he's kind of wandering around, and I immediately was like, 'No, this isn't what he wants to be doing. I don't want him here,' " she told the outlet. "So I went over and whispered, I was like, 'Go home,' and he was nice — he, like, talked to my parents and was polite — but I was like, 'Go.' "

When he left, "That just genuinely made me feel better," she added.

De Niro — who starred in 2012's Silver Linings Playbook , 2013's American Hustle and 2015's Joy with Lawrence — was asked about the wedding scenario during his turn on Vanity Fair 's lie detector test alongside his Focker-In-Law costars Ariana Grande and Ben Stiller .

"This famous actress said she asked you to leave her wedding after feeling worried that you weren't having a good time," Grande, 33, said while showing a photo of Lawrence in the video, which was released on Thursday, Nov. 19.

Grande asked if he was really upset or just have "an RBF (resting bitch face)."

"A resting bitch face? No, I was actually having an okay time," De Niro said. "It was an interesting experience, but I wasn't... There was nobody I knew there, not that I had to know anybody. It was their party, and so on. It was a great place to be."

He continued, "It was nice that Jennifer was being very sensitive to my situation, thinking that I was not having a good time, but I was okay."

In 2024, De Niro shared his recollection of the night with PEOPLE , saying that he wasn't uncomfortable even though Lawrence may think otherwise.

"No, I wasn't. It was nice!" he told PEOPLE at the time, adding that he was only there for about an hour. "It wasn't that long."

articles.title: Rob Lowe Explains Why He Signed onto Ben Shapiro’s New Film: ‘Why Wouldn’t I Work With Right-Wing Writers?’
articles.summary: The Daily Wire’s ‘Confession’ stars Lowe, James Franco, Nick Nolte and Jennifer Jason Leigh
articles.body:
Rob Lowe stars in Confession , distributed by right-wing media platform The Daily Wire and written by its co-founder Ben Shapiro

In a new interview, Lowe recalled signing onto the film after calling Shapiro to tell him the drama's script was "fantastic"

"I've worked with the most left-wing writers in the world. Why wouldn't I also work with the most right-wing writers in the world?" he said

Rob Lowe is recalling how he jumped at the chance to star in a new film from conservative commentator Ben Shapiro.

Confession , written by The Daily Wire founder, released on the streaming service on Nov. 11, simultaneously with its one-night-only theatrical release. The drama, set in Stalin's 1938 Moscow, stars Lowe as a Soviet spy being tortured.

Upon reading Shapiro's script, Lowe, 62, said on the Second Thought podcast Tuesday, Nov. 17, "I called Ben and said, 'This is fantastic.' And he was like, 'Well, do you think you know anybody 50-ish, leading man who would not be scared just because I wrote it?' And I go, 'Yeah, me.'"

Shapiro, 42, clarified: "And he goes, 'You're good with this?'" the actor recalled. "I said, 'I've worked with the most left-wing writers in the world. Why wouldn't I also work with the most right-wing writers in the world?'"

Confession , directed by Václav Marhoul, stars James Franco , Nick Nolte , Jennifer Jason Leigh , Kodi Smit-McPhee and Emile Hirsch in addition to Lowe. As the Parks and Recreation alum noted, the film did not screen at festivals.

"It is a tough watch, but I see the movies that are celebrated out there," said Lowe, saying that Confession was "summarily frog-marched out of any conversation" involving a film festival debut.

"The thought would be we'd play in a film festival, we would get some buzz — never happened — and then, you know, Netflix would pick it up or this one would pick it [up] — crickets. Absolute crickets. So then it defaults to The Daily Wire to be the distributor. And I'm like, 'Hell yeah!' I want people to see this movie."

The Daily Wire, the right-wing media company co-founded by Shapiro, has produced several screen projects, including the Run Hide Fight films and the documentaries Am I Racist? and What Is a Woman?

Lowe called his role in Confession "one of those opportunities that doesn't come my way very often," adding, "I get to do both drama and comedy, but this is at the most outer edge of drama, and it's obviously really grueling for the characters. It's unlike anything I've done."

articles.title: O mundo sem Claudette Soares... | G1
articles.body:
Claudette Soares (1935 – 2026) — Foto: Fábio Audi / Divulgação

♬ “Pode falar dois minutos?”. Não cheguei a estranhar a mensagem que recebi do produtor Marcus Preto no Whatsapp às 10h25 da sexta-feira passada, 13 de novembro. Afinal, ele era o idealizador do álbum de Claudette Soares (1935 – 2026), “O mundo é ruim para quem não sabe esperar” , que eu acabara de resenhar com entusiasmo aqui nesta coluna no g1 em crítica publicada precisamente às 6h13m.

Achei que ele fosse agradecer a crítica ou apontar algum erro de informação a ser corrigido. Grande engano! Ainda incrédulo, Preto ligou para me dar a notícia na qual nem ele nem ninguém conseguia acreditar. Claudette Soares tinha partido.

Sim, a cantora que lançara naquele dia um dos melhores álbuns da discografia tinha ido dormir na noite anterior de 12 de novembro e não acordou mais. Um artista partir no dia do lançamento de um álbum tão aguardado era uma situação inédita, pelo menos nos meus 40 anos de exercício do jornalismo musical.

Logo a notícia se espalharia e deixaria em choque o nicho do Brasil que conhecia a bossa e o suingue de Claudette Soares. Aquela notícia também provocou em mim um mix de choque, incredulidade e tristeza. Mas também um certo alívio por ter publicado a crítica do álbum “O mundo é ruim para quem não sabe esperar” antes da notícia da morte de Claudette.

Se tivesse sido escrita com a ciência de que a cantora já tinha saído de cena, a crítica talvez perdesse parte da credibilidade. Afinal, todo mundo ia achar que eu elogiava o álbum porque Claudette tinha acabado de morrer. É da natureza humana...

E o fato é que o mundo ficou sem a alegria de Claudette Soares. Mas permaneceu com a música, pois a obra da cantora está perpetuada em discografia que ainda merece passar por processo de reavaliação e revalorização. É incrível que os álbuns lançados pela cantora na década de 1960 nunca tenham sido reeditados em CD no Brasil. No Japão, país que venera a bossa brasileira, esses discos foram relançados. Coisas do Brasil...

Pela minha natureza retraída e também por uma questão de ética profissional, não me aproximo de artistas. Mas há alguns que se aproximam de mim e são sempre bem recebidos. Claudette, por exemplo. A cada texto escrito sobre ela aqui na coluna no g1 , vinha um áudio carinhoso da cantora por zap.

Esse carinho recorrente e espontâneo fez com que eu tivesse tomado a iniciativa de mandar um áudio para a artista em 31 de outubro, dia do 91º aniversário de Claudette. Dei os parabéns à cantora, desejei saúde para ela e sucesso para o álbum. Mal sabia eu que Claudette esperaria somente o álbum ser lançado naquela sexta-feira 13 para partir, numa trapaça da sorte.

Sim, hoje faz uma semana que o mundo ficou sem Claudette Soares... Um mundo que tem estado ruim e que ficou pior sem a graciosidade da cantora. Mas que pode ficar um pouco melhor para quem for ouvir “O mundo é ruim para quem não sabe esperar” , álbum tão cheio de frescor e sem ranço nostálgico, ainda que evoque em cada faixa o passado glorioso de Claudette na música brasileira. Pelo disco, a cantora mandou recado: meu tempo é hoje. Claudette Soares presente!

articles.body: Patrick Petty, best known for styling the iconic boy band New Kids on the Block, passed away at the age of 62 on Monday. He was a Boston-based fashion entrepreneur who had started his own brand and shop. He had also been working with New Kids on the Block for years now and was close friends with all of the members.Patrick Petty passes away at 62The news of Petty’s passing was shared online by longtime friend Sherman Evans in a report by MassLive. While few details about his passing were shared online, he was suffering from some medical complications, as shared by Evans. His daughter, Zoë Petty, also shared a statement with the outlet, saying he “fought till the very, very end... His soul was incredibly strong.”Donnie Wahlberg and wife Jenny McCarthy remember Patrick PettyPetty knew all of the members of New Kids on the Block and had been working with them since their inception. Wahlberg took to his Instagram following the news of his passing and shared a heartfelt note for his close friend.His post read, “Rest peacefully, my dear friend and brother, Patrick Petty. We’ve had almost 40 years of friendship. We’ve travelled the world together, had the most amazing times together, seen championships together, and shared triumphs and losses together." He recalled some of their good times over the years, how they “watched each other’s children grow up,” and how they had spent “more late nights ‘talking ‘til the sun came up' than I can even count. We laughed. We cried. We’ve truly been through it all, and then some! It’s like we’ve lived a dozen lifetimes together—all in one precious friendship!” Lastly, he talked about the legacy and work that Petty is leaving behind and concluded his post by writing, “Personally, you were a true friend in every sense of the word," further adding, “I will see you again, my dear friend!" I love you so much, Pat. Godspeed!”Jenny McCarthy also posted a photo of her and Petty together and shared a heartfelt note remembering the stylist. “You don’t meet many people in this life who have the heart of an angel, the patience of a saint, and an extraordinary gift for their craft. Pat was one of those rare souls,” she wrote, further adding, “I will miss you, Pat. Your kindness, love, and gentle spirit touched everyone lucky enough to know you. You made the world a better place simply by being in it. Rest peacefully, my friend. You will never be forgotten.”Petty had earlier talked about his friendship with Wahlberg in a 2016 interview with Boston Magazine. At the time, he shared how the two had been working together since the inception of New Kids on the Block and how they had bonded over the years. “Every time the Patriots have played in the Super Bowl, we’ve gone together. When he got married to Jenny, he said, ‘Don’t worry, I still got you for the Super Bowl.’ He said, ‘You’re not my plus-one; you’re my plus-one and a half,’” he had shared.Patrick Petty had been managing his own store brand since the 1990s, which had slowly grown into a successful business over the years. His daughter shared more insight into who her father was while talking to the outlet. She commented, “He always really believed in paying it forward, and he mentored a lot of people. articles.title: 'What was I thinking?': Karan Johar questions Anjali's sweets delivery scene in  'Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham';  wonders how one tray could feed 1,000 guests
articles.summary: Filmmaker Karan Johar recently revisited one of the most memorable sequences from his 2001 family drama 'Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham'.
articles.body: Filmmaker Karan Johar recently revisited one of the most memorable sequences from his 2001 family drama 'Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham'. As the movie approaches its 25th anniversary, Karan Johar and actress Kareena Kapoor Khan took a trip down memory lane. During the celebrations, the filmmaker also pointed out a few amusing details that he now finds difficult to justify. One particular scene involving Kajol's character, Anjali, became the subject of his humorous observation.Karan Johar and Kareena Kapoor Khan revisit the movie's setsTo mark the movie's 25-year milestone, Karan Johar and Kareena Kapoor Khan visited a recreated version of the original 'Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham' set in Mumbai's Juhu area. The location holds special significance as several portions of the family entertainer were filmed there. The reunion brought back memories of the movie's production and some of its most recognisable moments.During the gathering, Karan Johar spoke about the scenes that have remained popular with audiences over the years. He also reflected on certain creative decisions made while putting the story together. Among them was a sequence featuring Kajol and Simone Singh, who played Anjali and her friend Rukhsar, respectively.Anjali's birthday party dilemma in 'Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham'In the movie, Anjali runs a sweet shop and receives an order to provide desserts for a birthday celebration at the Raichand residence. The event is organised for Yashvardhan Raichand, played by Amitabh Bachchan. However, the occasion also coincides with the birthday of Anjali's father, played by Alok Nath.Anjali initially attends her father's birthday celebration before rushing to complete the sweets delivery. She is accompanied by Rukhsar as the two women head towards the Raichand mansion. The sequence captures their hurried journey as they attempt to fulfil the order despite the competing family commitments.Karan Johar questions the one-tray sweets logicRevisiting the scene after more than two decades, Karan Johar noticed an amusing detail about the delivery. The filmmaker wondered how Anjali expected to serve an entire gathering with just one tray of traditional Indian sweets. The Raichand birthday celebration was attended by approximately 1,000 guests, making the quantity particularly questionable.Karan also questioned the practical side of the sequence. He wondered whether Anjali and Rukhsar could realistically run from their neighbourhood to the Raichand mansion within the time shown in the movie. The filmmaker's observations turned into a light-hearted assessment of the scene's creative logic.'What was I thinking?' Karan Johar laughs at his own sceneSpeaking about the sequence, Karan Johar openly acknowledged its questionable details. He pointed out the difficulty of catering to such a large gathering with a single tray of sweets. The filmmaker also questioned the distance between the two locations.As quoted by IANS, he said, "And I really want to know, I mean, even if Mrs Raichand (played by Jaya Bachchan) asked for dessert, and there were about 1000 people at that party, what were they doing with one thal of mithai and how were they planning to feed that whole party? What the logic of that is, and did they actually think that that neighbourhood was running distance to that mansion? What was I thinking? Clearly, I wasn't."Directed by Karan Johar, 'Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham' was released in 2001. The movie featured Amitabh Bachchan, Jaya Bachchan, Shah Rukh Khan, Kajol, Hrithik Roshan and Kareena Kapoor Khan in prominent roles.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. The 'Blast' actor expressed his displeasure over the personal remarks being circulated about her and warned of legal consequences for those responsible. He also criticised sections of the media for spreading unverified claims and questioned the lack of sensitivity towards women's privacy.Aishwarya Arjun married actor Umapathy Ramaiah in 2024. However, speculation about their relationship has recently gained attention following Umapathy Ramaiah's reported absence from the wedding celebrations of Aishwarya's younger sister, Anjana. The development triggered discussions about a possible disagreement between the couple. Several unverified claims about Aishwarya Arjun's personal life also began circulating online.Arjun Sarja addresses speculation about Aishwarya Arjun's marriageThe actor has now responded to the controversy through a lengthy social media statement. Arjun Sarja explained that he had previously avoided discussing his elder daughter's personal matters to respect her privacy. However, he felt compelled to speak after noticing increasingly derogatory remarks about her character.Beginning his statement, Arjun Sarja thanked everyone who had extended their wishes to his family following Anjana's wedding. He wrote, "Firstly, I would like to thank everyone who has sent their love and wonderful wishes to Anjana and our family on her wedding. Your affection and goodwill have always meant a great deal to us, and we remain grateful to everyone who has kept us in their thoughts."Actor condemns personal attacks and character assassinationArjun Sarja said speculation about Aishwarya Arjun's personal life had emerged following her younger sister's marriage. He maintained that his daughter should have the freedom to make her own decisions without facing public judgement.He further stated, "When my younger daughter got married, there was considerable speculation surrounding my elder daughter, Aishwarya Arjun’s, personal life. I have consciously chosen to respect her privacy and refrain from commenting on matters that are hers alone to share. Every woman has the right to make her own choices and live life on her own terms. She will speak for herself, in her own time, should she choose to.However, as a father, I cannot remain silent when I see false and deeply derogatory allegations being made about my daughter, her character and her personal life."Arjun Sarja objects to alcoholic remarks and confirms complaintThe actor particularly objected to allegations questioning his daughter's character. He also addressed remarks labelling a woman an alcoholic without supporting evidence. According to Arjun Sarja, public attention and scrutiny should never become an excuse for spreading damaging personal accusations.He also revealed that the family had initiated formal action against those circulating such claims. "We have always believed that silence is often the most dignified response. But silence should never be mistaken for acceptance, nor should it allow misinformation to be repeatedly circulated and amplified. We have therefore taken the appropriate steps by lodging a formal complaint with the concerned authorities."Actor criticises sensationalism in media reportingArjun Sarja also expressed disappointment with certain sections of the media. Although he acknowledged his respect for journalism and reporting, he criticised the practice of sensationalising personal allegations to attract attention.He added that such incidents could have serious consequences for women, particularly those who lack adequate family support. The actor stressed that no woman should be forced to defend her personal choices against public accusations.Arjun Sarja warns of further legal actionConcluding his statement, Arjun Sarja reaffirmed his support for Aishwarya Arjun and her right to lead an independent life. He also issued a warning against the continued circulation of defamatory content.He wrote, "As a father, I will always stand by my daughter and her right to live with dignity, independence and freedom. I trust that those responsible will exercise due caution hereafter. Any further circulation or amplification of such baseless and defamatory allegations will be dealt with through appropriate legal recourse. Respect and dignity should never be negotiable.Truly,Arjun Sarja19.11.2026."On the professional front, Arjun Sarja's 2026 releases include 'Blast'.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: 'Sharad Kapoor health update; Hema Chaudhary shares latest details, 'Some reports came in today, Doctors strongly suggested complete bed rest'
articles.summary: Actor Sharad Kapoor has started receiving medical attention after a prolonged period of health and personal difficulties.
articles.body: Actor Sharad Kapoor has started receiving medical attention after a prolonged period of health and personal difficulties. His friend and spokesperson, Hema Chaudhary, has revealed that doctors have recommended complete bed rest and isolation for a week. The actor has also been asked to stay away from phone calls and social interactions during this period.Sharad Kapoor has reportedly been dealing with the effects of a leg injury sustained two years ago. He has also spoken about battling depression and financial difficulties. Several members of the film industry, including Shah Rukh Khan, Salman Khan and Sonu Sood, have recently reached out to offer assistance.Hema Chaudhary shares Sharad Kapoor's health updateIn a video post, Hema Chaudhary explained that Sharad Kapoor's medical tests are underway. Doctors are expected to decide on the further course of treatment after examining his blood reports. She also confirmed that the actor has already begun receiving medical attention."Sharad ke saare blood tests chalu ho gaye hain; kuch reports aaj aaye, kuch kal ya day after aayenge. According to that, doctors will line up the necessary treatment. It has already started. Doctors have strongly suggested that he needs complete bed rest." ("All of Sharad's blood tests have started; some reports came in today, while others will arrive tomorrow or the day after.")She said the actor needs time to recover without the pressure of constant communication. She added that the recent attention from fans, journalists and industry colleagues has become overwhelming for him. Actor advised to stay away from phone callsHema Chaudhary revealed that Sharad Kapoor's phone is currently switched off and remains with her. Doctors have advised him to avoid answering calls for at least a week. The temporary break is intended to help him concentrate on his recovery.According to Hema Chaudhary, Sharad Kapoor had largely stayed away from social interactions for nearly two years. The sudden attention surrounding his health has therefore been difficult for him to handle. She also shared a positive update about his current condition, saying, "Good news yeh hai ki he's eating well and he's happy."Singer Sonu Nigam was among the latest personalities to contact the actor. He reportedly sent Sharad Kapoor a voice note, which helped improve his mood during this difficult period.Hema Chaudhary explains why isolation is necessaryHema Chaudhary believes that continuous phone conversations and social interactions could further affect Sharad Kapoor's mental well-being. She explained that doctors had recommended isolation to give him sufficient time and space to recover."Kind of bed rest hai and kind of isolation hai. Kyunki agar aise hi chalta raha toh dimaagi santulant aur bigadta jayega." ("He needs a kind of bed rest and isolation. Otherwise, if things continue this way, his mental health could deteriorate further.")Hema Chaudhary also assured fans that she would continue sharing updates about the actor's condition. His latest medical reports are awaited, and the specific reason behind his current health concerns has not been disclosed.Sharad Kapoor had earlier spoken about battling depression for around two years. His prolonged withdrawal from social life was reportedly accompanied by financial difficulties and other personal challenges.Shah Rukh Khan offers help to his former co-starMeanwhile, Sharad Kapoor recently revealed that Shah Rukh Khan personally contacted him and offered assistance. The two actors previously worked together in the movie 'Josh'. In an interview with Navbharat Times, Sharad Kapoor spoke about the superstar's gesture and the support he had received from the industry. Shah Rukh Khan reportedly assured Sharad Kapoor that he would be willing to help him in any way necessary. The actor also revealed that he was planning to meet Shah Rukh Khan's son, Aryan Khan, the following day. Despite the challenges he has faced, Sharad Kapoor remains hopeful about resuming his acting career.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.summary: 'Ramayana: Rise Of A Legend' starring Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, Yash, Lara Dutta, Kajal Aggarwal, Ravie Dubey among others has been doing exceptionally
articles.body: 'Ramayana: Rise Of A Legend' starring Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, Yash, Lara Dutta, Kajal Aggarwal, Ravie Dubey among others has been doing exceptionally well at the box office. It has now completed two weeks of release and has crossed several records. As it now enters its third week, it has begun to see a gradual drop in the numbers. 'Ramayana: Part 1' made Rs 564 crore by the end of its first week.It saw a growth over the second weekend which was quite encouraging and kept the momentum going for the film. While it made Rs 75 crore on Sunday, November 15, it saw a drop of 57 percent on Monday and made Rs 32 crore. Since then, it has now started seeing a downfall and the third weekend will further decide the film's pace in the coming week. On day 15, Thursday, it made Rs 19.35 crore and on day 16, November 20, Friday, till afternoon it has made Rs 7.91 crore. The total collection of 'Ramayana' is now Rs 871.66 crore net in India, according to Sacnilk.The Hindi version of 'Ramayana' remains the only Indian-language film market to have crossed the Rs 650 crore net mark. Telugu is the next biggest market, with 'RRR' being the only film to cross Rs 400 crore net. It achieved the milestone in 16 days and eventually finished at Rs 431.01 crore. No Tamil, Kannada or Malayalam film has crossed the Rs 400 crore net mark so far, as per Sacnilk.The film's second-week performance has also been remarkable. After 'Dhurandhar 2', 'Ramayana' has become the second Hindi film of 2026 to collect over Rs 200 crore in its second week. Trade analyst Taran Adarsh highlighted the achievement, writing, "Film has crossed ₹ 200 cr in Week 2 - becoming only the second #Hindi film in 2026, after #Dhurandhar2, to achieve this phenomenal milestone in its second week... articles.title: ‘Austin Powers’ star Mike Myers seems to think liberal Hollywood is just ‘groovy’
articles.summary: Mike Myers teased political commentary for "Austin Powers" in a Variety interview posted on Veterans Day, Nov. 11, saying "the world has happened."
articles.body: On Veterans Day, Nov. 11, Variety posted a quick interview with actor Mike Myers on X that has over 600,000 views and counting. At the outset, I should state that I have long been a fan of Myers. Partially because of his demonstrated talent and partially because of my Scottish and Canadian roots. Now, the reason the Variety post is getting so much attention is because Myers hints that he may make "Austin Powers" a bit more political. During the interview, Variety asked Myers if the forthcoming film featuring Powers would "reflect" the current political climate. Myers – with tongue seemingly firmly in cheek – answered in part: "I can neither confirm nor deny the existence or nonexistence of such a commentary. I mean the world has happened. But it's a much happier world, Austin's world, so it's been a lot of fun. I'm really enjoying it." ROB LOWE CALLS OUT HOLLYWOOD DOUBLE STANDARD AFTER FESTIVALS REJECT BEN SHAPIRO-WRITTEN FILM Some took note of Myers' answer regarding "the world has happened, but it’s a much happier world" was given just a week after the Democrats crushed Trump and the Republican Party on Nov. 3. Myers then seemed to add weight to that observation by adding: "But I have to say, in the last few weeks, I think fear has had it, and love is on the way back." The reporter from Variety then pushed Myers on that answer. "The wave of happiness, the blue wave?" Myers faltered for a second, seemingly recognizing the need for political diplomacy before confirming which side of the political divide he inhabits. DAVID SPADE AND DANA CARVEY CALL OUT HOLLYWOOD FOR FOCUSING TOO MUCH ON RACE AND GENDER "No, well, it’s not — regardless of left or right, though I am a lefty, I’m Canadian, I’m a progressive, always have been," Myers said. "I just think we’re sick of fear, and we want more love." To Myers, I would ask: What "fear" are you sick of and what "fear" do you think "has had it?" Care to elaborate? HOLLYWOOD PRODUCER BEHIND 'APOLLO 13' REJECTS POLITICS IN HIS MOVIES, SEEKS TO UNITE AUDIENCES I would then tell Myers that I – like the vast majority of citizens in the United States, Canada and around the world – come from the "working-class," "blue-collar," life-is-a-daily-struggle side of the financial divide. And I, like most from that world, begrudge Myers none of his success, enormous wealth and the entrenched-elite bubble it allows him to reside within. All we ask of Myers is that he remember that life is very, very hard for most people. And when they can afford to go to a movie or pay for one via a streaming service, they simply want to be entertained. They want and need an entertainment vehicle which will help to decompress their constantly troubled minds. The last thing they want is to go to a movie and have entrenched elites from Hollywood — many who barely finished high school — lecture them, speak down to them or outright insult them and their beliefs and faith. DEAN CAIN SAYS HOLLYWOOD'S WOKE ERA IS ENDING: 'WE'LL LOOK BACK AND SAY THAT WAS STUPID' Sadly, that has not been the case for well over the last decade. The "Marvel Cinematic Universe," the "Star Wars" franchise and multiple other films have continually and increasingly overloaded their "entertainment" with "woke" narratives and identity politics-driven characters. A strategy which has collectively cost those studios billions of dollars. I would then ask Myers if he truly understands how that is possible. The correct answer being that over the course of the last five-plus decades, those with the ability to hire in Hollywood have systematically discriminated against Republicans, conservatives and people of faith. LIBERAL FACULTY STILL HUGELY OUTNUMBER CONSERVATIVES IN HIGHER EDUCATION: REPORT Myers proclaims: "I am a lefty … I’m a progressive voter, always have been." Honestly, good for him. He should — and must — be able to identify with a political or ideological doctrine which makes the most sense to him. Just as he should be able to shout it out. That said, my next question to Myers would be: Do you honestly think Republican-leaning or conservative actors in Hollywood have the luxury — and the right — to shout out, "I am a righty … I’m a conservative voter, always have been," without fear of serious repercussions to their careers and very livelihoods? Has that fear "had it," Mr. Myers? Some took note of Myers' answer regarding "the world has happened, but it’s a much happier world" was given just a week after the Democrats crushed Trump and the Republican Party on Nov. 3. And, to extrapolate upon that, I have long maintained that over the course of that same five decades-plus, the left has secured a vicelike grip on what I call the "five major megaphones" of our nation. Those being: the media, academia, entertainment, science and medicine. Do you think that at Yale University, where over 95% of the faculty supports the Democratic Party, that a conservative professor or student can shout out: "I am a righty … I’m a conservative voter, always have been," without fearing for their jobs or chance to graduate? The same question applies to the media, science and medicine. Going back to the interview with Variety, Myers would do well to read the comments. The very idea of him politicizing Austin Powers has outraged most. CLICK HERE FOR MORE FOX NEWS OPINION Understanding that, I have a suggestion for Myers. He should have Austin Powers jump into his 1999 Volkswagen New Beetle time machine and go back at least five decades to fight the multiple "Dr. Evils" blatantly discriminating against those in the film industry who dare to have contrary beliefs. articles.title: Stabbed Bradford councillor was 'protecting council staff member'
articles.summary: Bradford councillor Ibrar Ali remains in hospital in a stable condition after he was stabbed.
articles.body:
A councillor was trying to protect a member of council staff when he was stabbed while doing community work in his ward, his family has said.

Councillor Ibrar Ali remains in hospital in a stable condition after he was attacked at about 11:04 GMT on Thursday on Thornbury Avenue, before being driven to nearby Manse Street, according to police.

A 32-year-old man was arrested on suspicion of attempted murder after a stand-off on the roof of a home on Thornbury Avenue that lasted more than three hours. He remains in custody.

A statement on behalf of the independent councillor's family said he had intervened to protect a council staff member and "sustained multiple stab wounds".

Ali was doing street cleaning with Bradford Council staff when the incident happened.

The family statement continued: "Alhamdulillah [praise be to God], although his injuries are serious, they are not life-threatening. He is currently receiving treatment in hospital and remains in a stable condition.

"The family would like to express their heartfelt gratitude to everyone who has offered prayers, kind words and messages of support during this difficult time," they said.

The family thanked police, paramedics and members of the public who "courageously provided first aid and assistance at the scene" and said asked members of the public to "keep him and his family in your duas [prayers]".

"The family kindly requests privacy and understanding to allow Councillor Ibrar the time and space he needs to rest, heal and recover," it said.

Ali is a Your Bradford Independent Group councillor for Bradford Moor ward and was first elected in May.

He works as a community development manager at charity The Leap, and was one of the founders of Leeds Road Festival.

Earlier West Yorkshire Police said there was "no information to suggest that this is a politically motivated incident at this time".

A spokesperson for Your Bradford Independent Group said they were "deeply shocked and concerned" by the stabbing.

"Such an attack is completely unacceptable. Violence has no place in our communities, and nobody should have to fear for their safety while carrying out their duties or going about their daily lives.

"Councillors dedicate their time to representing residents, supporting communities and making a difference to people's lives. Their safety and wellbeing must be taken seriously," they said.

articles.body: Actor Dhanush has often made headlines for his films, but his personal life and lifestyle have also attracted public attention. His luxurious residence in Chennai's Poes Garden is one such talking point. Reportedly worth Rs 150 crore, the mansion reflects the actor's taste and offers several facilities, including a private gym, swimming pool, home theatre and dedicated workspaces. The property, which he reportedly bought for his parents, has also become a subject of interest among fans.About Dhanush's Poes Garden houseAccording to reports by Magicbricks, the multi-storey residence has been designed to provide comfort and privacy for the family. The ground floor reportedly features a spacious living room, a pooja room and an indoor garden. The space also has enough room for children to play. The first floor houses the master bedroom, guest rooms and a home theatre. Framed posters of some of Dhanush's popular films, including 'VIP' and 'Asuran', are also said to be part of the interiors. The upper floor reportedly has a personal workspace, a dubbing setup and a separate room where the actor can read scripts. The mansion also features a private gym and a swimming pool. Outside, the property has a lawn, a terrace garden and covered parking space for several cars.Dhanush reveals why he wanted to own a house in Poes GardenThe story behind the expensive property is closely connected to one of Dhanush's childhood dreams. During the audio launch of his film 'Raayan', the actor spoke about the reason behind his decision to buy a house in the neighbourhood. He recalled visiting Poes Garden when he was just 16 years old with a friend. As a huge Rajinikanth fan, he had gone there hoping to see the superstar's residence. He also spotted the house of former Tamil Nadu Chief Minister J Jayalalithaa during the visit. The experience left a lasting impression on him, and he decided that he would own a house in the area someday.Dhanush calls his Poes Garden mansion a gift to his 16-year-old selfAddressing the attention surrounding his property, Dhanush said he would have chosen a small apartment if he had known that buying a house in Poes Garden would become such a big topic. He also questioned why he should not own a house in the neighbourhood. Recalling his childhood ambition, the actor said the mansion was a gift to his 16-year-old self. He described the purchase as a dream he had visualised years ago and eventually fulfilled through his hard work. For Dhanush, the residence is therefore more than an expensive property; it represents a childhood wish that turned into reality.Dhanush earns praise for 'O.M'On the movie front, Dhanush is now getting accolades for his role in the movie 'OM: Operation Mole'. articles.title: 'Hanuman Ansh' director says none of the big production houses congratulated the film despite its Rs 400 crore success, says controlling a film's budget is pivotal: 'ROI that determines whether a film is a success or a failure'
articles.summary: ‘Hanuman Ansh’ which was based on Neem Karoli Baba, emerged as a major box-office success, as it garnered Rs 400 crore gross in India, crore against a
articles.body: ‘Hanuman Ansh’ which was based on Neem Karoli Baba, emerged as a major box-office success, as it garnered Rs 400 crore gross in India, crore against a reported budget of just Rs 2 crore. It proved to be a sleeper hit and with that, is one of the most profitable movies of the year. However, despite the film's impressive performance, director Vishal Chaturvedi feels that its achievement has not received the recognition it deserves from established production houses. In a recent interaction, the filmmaker opened up about the lack of acknowledgement from big studios and how the film has challenged conventional beliefs about box-office success.Vishal said he was surprised that none of the major production houses had publicly acknowledged the film's success. He said in an interview with Screen, "I have seen so many official statements after a big film works at the box office, but because ours is a small film by a first-time director, I didn't see any statement from any big production house, not even one. That's very surprising."He further revealed that while several people have personally appreciated the film, only a handful of prominent personalities have openly praised its performance. He added, "But when people meet me, they speak volumes about the film. There are only a few people with big hearts who praised it out loud, including Varun Dhawan, Virender Sehwag, and many others. No big studio or established production house wrote a letter or statement about the success of the film."Vishal Chaturvedi says 'Hanuman Ansh' has challenged the big-budget formulaThe director also reflected on how the film's unexpected success has challenged the widely held perception that only projects featuring established stars, massive budgets and backing from major studios can perform well at the box office.Sharing his perspective, Vishal said, "That myth has been broken, that only a big star, a big budget, or a major studio can make a film successful. Cinema is a people's medium. The audience watches and decides if it's a good film, but earlier it was the critics and social media that used to give that conclusion to the people."Vishal also stressed the importance of financial planning before a filmmaker begins working on a project. During the conversation, he was asked whether he had watched Nitesh Tiwari's ‘Ramayana’, which is reportedly being made on a combined budget of Rs 4,000 crore for its two instalments.Admitting that he had not managed to watch it yet, the director said, "I haven't found the time because I am running here and there, but I'm really eager to watch it."Why filmmakers should be mindful of the budgetsExplaining why financial viability should be an important consideration for filmmakers, Vishal pointed out that a film's commercial performance cannot be separated from the money invested in making it. He observed that when a project mounted on a Rs 200 crore budget fails to generate Rs 400 crore in revenue, it is often categorised as a box-office failure.Elaborating on the importance of return on investment, he continued, "It is a simple calculation of return on investment (ROI) that determines whether a film is a success or a failure. When a filmmaker makes a film, it is very important to be mindful of the total budget because it will eventually determine the film's success. Sometimes, beautiful films made on high budgets fail to succeed because they don't achieve the required numbers and are labelled box-office failures. The script of the film is also very important."Meanwhile, a sequel to ‘Hanuman Ansh’ was announced earlier but has reportedly been put on hold amid a dispute between the producers. Addressing its future, Vishal said he is currently waiting to see how audiences respond to the film when it premieres on OTT on November 27. He indicated that the next course of action would depend on the response it receives after its digital release.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Yogi Adityanath reaches ancestral village Panchur, pays last respects to mother
articles.summary: PANCHUR: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath on Friday visited his ancestral village of Panchur in Uttarakhand's Pauri Garhwal district to pay
articles.body: PANCHUR: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath on Friday visited his ancestral village of Panchur in Uttarakhand's Pauri Garhwal district to pay his last respects to his mother, Savitri Devi, who passed away earlier in the day on the occasion of the Igas festival.Her demise has plunged the village and surrounding areas into grief, with political leaders and residents mourning her loss.Yogi offered floral tributes to his mother after arriving at the village.A wave of grief has swept through Panchur and the surrounding region following her death.Speaking to ANI, Uttarakhand Assembly Speaker Ritu Khanduri expressed condolences and paid tribute to the strength of the chief minister's mother."The respected mother of the Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh, Honorable Yogi ji, passed away today in Panchur. The departure of a mother is a huge loss, and losing a mother brings immense sorrow. Especially such a mother, who showed great magnanimity and must have been a very strong mother to have inspired her son toward renunciation (sanyas) and inspired him to serve the nation. So, all of us are deeply saddened. Losing a mother is a tremendous sorrow for anyone; it is an irreparable loss. I pray to the Almighty to grant her a place at His holy feet and give the family the strength to bear this immense grief," Khanduri said.Referring to the widespread mourning, she added, "There certainly is a wave of mourning. A son who has served the country and served the state so devotedly-so naturally, everyone feels as if they have lost their own mother today."Former Panchur Pradhan Satendra Singh Negi said Savitri Devi was around 91 years old and had been unwell for the past few years.Speaking to ANI, Negi said, "Today morning around 9:30 to 9:45 AM, Mata ji passed away. For the past two to three years, she had been keeping unwell. She was at home, in the village, in Panchur. And this morning, she breathed her last. She was around 91 years old. Sick for the past one to two years, ill and unwell, she was elderly, so she had been in failing health. And her care-all three daughters-in-law and her three sons were looking after her. And today, on the occasion of the Igas festival, she passed away. On this festival today, she departed from this mortal body, and may God grant peace to her soul."Speaking about the family's standing in the region and the mood following her death, he added, "Right now, there is an atmosphere of mourning across the area and the village. She was very amiable; although she had grown elderly lately, they have always been sociable, warm, and community-minded people in this region. So, among all the people in this entire area right now, there is an atmosphere of deep sorrow."Earlier in the day, Prime Minister Narendra Modi spoke to Yogi Adityanath and offered his condolences on his mother's demise.Meanwhile, a two-minute silence was observed in memory of Savitri Devi during the Mahila Morcha Pradesh Pravas meeting.
